snippet: Your shop answers customers by itself. Free, on your own computer. Customers reach you on WhatsApp or Telegram. OwnShop AI answers from your own Excel sheet and FAQ, takes orders and bookings, and tells them how to pay: UPI, payment link, QR code or bank transfer. No AI bill…
excerpt: Your shop answers customers by itself. Free, on your own computer. Customers reach you on WhatsApp or Telegram. OwnShop AI answers from your own Excel sheet and FAQ, takes orders and bookings, and tells them how to pay: UPI, payment link, QR code or bank transfer. No AI bill, no hosting, no domain. Windows (x64 or ARM64) and Mac with Apple silicon. About 700 MB, the AI model is included. Today you answer every message by hand. "Price?" "In stock?" "Do you deliver on Saturday?" "Where is my order?" Your list lives in an Excel sheet and your shop lives in WhatsApp and Telegram chats. Every answer waits for you. The usual fix costs money every month: a chatbot service, an AI subscription, a paid auto-reply tool, hosting and a domain for a shop website. OwnShop AI needs none of them. Three steps, no technical person needed Nothing to type in a terminal and no account to create. Everything happens in your browser, on your own computer. Install Double-click the download. OwnShop AI installs itself and opens the setup in your browser. Upload your Excel sheet Products, prices, stock and your own questions and answers. Or pick your business type for bookings. Connect WhatsApp or Telegram Scan a code with your phone or paste a Telegram bot token. The built-in web chat works right away for testing: log in with any email or phone and a password. Every step, with screenshots: the manual. From install to the first order A real run on a Windows PC with a demo shop: install, the setup steps, a customer asking for honey, the order, the payment request and the receipt. What it does for your customers Every reply is filled in from your own data, so it does not invent a price or a policy. The small AI only decides what the customer wants. Answers questions Opening hours, delivery, returns: add a question once on the FAQ page (or in the FAQ sheet) and the shop answers it from then on, in your own words, before the AI is even asked. Catalog and prices Customers ask "do you have honey?"…
